feeds.title: Harmony Natural Care Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Katayoun (Katy). I am a Certified Clinical Iridologist, and a Certified Nutritional Practitioner (CNP) based in London, Ontario. I offer a range of consultations, specially designed for you, to reach your optimal levels of health and wellness not on deprivation and painful restrictions, but vitality, mindfulness, and joy. My areas of specialty are to use Iridology as a tool that can be used to identify areas of health or weakness within the body's systems and identify the root cause of health issues.

feeds.title: Show Me Your Set Blog
feeds.description: Elle Scott is a Certified Iridologist and Cellular Regenerative Detox Specialist out of Southwest Florida. After 17 years in corporate technology sales with Fortune 100 companies including AWS and HPE, she went full force into doing what she loves most: helping others. Elle guides individuals from all over the globe on how to regain vitality in their physical, mental, and emotional health, all from just the study of their eyes.

feeds.title: Alexandra Gellman Blog » Iridology
feeds.description: My name is Alexandra Gellman, and here is a brief biography.I was born in Mexico but immigrated with my family to Canada at an early age. My ancestry is the foundation of my life; my mother's father came from a long line of prominent Yaqui Indians from the northern state of Sonora, Mexico, who were renowned for their shamanistic abilities.

feeds.title: HippyBritt Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Brittani, and I am a certified lymphatic iridologist, regenerative detoxification specialist, and a mother of 3. I have been aiding clients on their healing journey for the better part of the last 10 years. I help people reverse chronic illness by taking a deep look into their bodies using iridology and creating a plan of action on a path toward detoxification.
